ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) across the central surface with low-intensity black pixel concentrations (approx. 15%) localized at the trailing edge and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast black patches mapped to the inner median notch region and along the trailing edge serrations; isolated vertical dark pixel streaks are distributed across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a sharply defined vertex; approximate pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel amplitude peaks reach 15-20 pixels in height, particularly on the distal regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed on the leading edges of both lobes, transitioning into a concave taper towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, textured dark pixels on the outer tip and trailing edge of the right lobe; sparse dark circular spots near the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible; notable parallel trio of vertical lines on the left lobe and intersecting marks on the right lobe near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular textured protrusion is visible on the far-right distal tip, indicative of extensive barnacle colonization or localized physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique three-line parallel vertical rake mark pattern located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe's ventral surface.
